shared_elements: human or humanoid figure in profile, standing/striding
raised arm with open hand gesture
carved script/signs integrated into the scene
low-relief figural scene on a rectangular-ish slab
justification: Both show a profile figure in low relief with a raised arm and inscribed signs on the surface, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows a seated deity-like figure with a standing offerer bringing offerings, with signs packed in a field above/between them, while B shows a single large bird-headed winged genius amid stylised palmette plants under a horizontal band of dense text — different subjects, different compositions, and different rendering conventions (schematic outline vs. dense feather and petal hatching).
